findings.finding: Unreserved GetFunctionConcurrency returns HTTP 200 with wire ReservedConcurrentExecutions:null; CLI decoding omits the field. Reserved zero is explicitly present as integer zero, not absence. Successful deletes have HTTP 204 and empty wire body, including never-reserved and repeated deletion.

Missing functions produce ResourceNotFoundException/404 for Get, Put zero and Delete. Their retained messages distinguish Get unqualified function ARN from Put/Delete appending $LATEST; messages are evidence, not exact-wording assertions.
Unqualified names, full ARNs and account-qualified partial ARNs address one reservation. Zero, one, replacement with two, and repeating two succeeded. No positive allocation exceeded two units.

All three concurrency APIs reject qualified names/ARNs with InvalidParameterValueException/400, including $LATEST, a real published version, a real alias and a missing alias. The shared Smithy FunctionName regex admitting suffixes does not imply operation support. Root reservation remained zero after rejected qualified mutations.

Excessive 1000000 and 2147483648 requests reached native AWS and failed InvalidParameterValueException/400 with the unreserved-floor quota message. This proves excessive requests reject atomically, not the exact admissible boundary or an int32 wire maximum. Boolean true reached AWS and failed SerializationException/400. A malformed owned function name reached all three APIs and failed ValidationException/400.

Negative, fractional, string, null and missing reserved counts were rejected by AWS CLI ParamValidation without a captured service response. These observations do not establish native service behavior for those payloads.

Changing a reservation from absent to zero, zero to one, or one to absent changes only RevisionId in the compared GetFunctionConfiguration outputs; LastModified stays unchanged. Same-value Put, never-reserved Delete, repeated Delete and rejected excessive Put leave the full observed configuration unchanged.

An assumed-role session allowing the three controls on the exact unqualified function ARN permits name/full/partial access and zero Put/Delete. The same grant denies alias-qualified calls with AccessDeniedException/403 before semantic validation, and denies another uniquely owned absent name. A qualified-only alias grant denies unqualified Get but gets InvalidParameterValueException/400 for all alias-qualified controls. Authorization therefore retains requested qualification; do not normalize away qualifiers before IAM.

GetFunctionConcurrency permission alone does not permit Put or Delete (403). GetAccountSettings scoped to a function ARN is denied on resource *, while a Resource:* grant succeeds. Base identity and narrowing session policies, trust documents and assumed identities are retained; no IAM user keys were created.

105 CloudTrail events correlate by exact native API response request ID. GetFunctionConcurrency is readOnly:true; PutFunctionConcurrency20171031 and DeleteFunctionConcurrency20171031 are readOnly:false. Correlated success examples retain responseElements:null. Get lookup Resources is empty, while Put/Delete lookup Resources identify AWS::Lambda::Function by function name; the embedded event resources member is absent.
